blocks.text: 特朗普总统大约一年前听取了相关简报，但没有采取任何行动，很可能是为了避免影响英伟达的芯片销售，或进一步加剧与中国的贸易关系紧张。黄仁勋并未被告知此事。美国官员当时认为他对此毫不知情。

blocks.text: 美国政府怀疑Megaspeed帮助中国获取英伟达芯片。2024年6月至2026年2月期间，其马来西亚姊妹公司采购了价值至少48亿美元、搭载英伟达芯片的AI硬件。英伟达发言人表示，与客户会面是CEO工作的一部分，Megaspeed并不会获得敏感信息。Megaspeed已宣布启动内部调查。中国大使馆发言人驳斥这些指控，称其是“毫无根据的抹黑和诽谤”。

blocks.text: US intelligence agencies believe an executive in Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's circle is an informant for China. According to The New York Times, the executive is Alice Huang (Huang Le) of Megaspeed, a Singapore-based data center operator. The report says US authorities found while monitoring her that she passes information to Beijing and is close to Jensen Huang.

blocks.text: The US government suspects Megaspeed of helping China get access to Nvidia chips. Between June 2024 and February 2026, a Malaysian sister company bought at least $4.8 billion worth of AI hardware with Nvidia chips. An Nvidia spokesperson says meeting with customers is part of a CEO's job and that Megaspeed doesn't receive sensitive information. Megaspeed has announced an internal investigation. A spokesperson for the Chinese embassy dismissed the allegations as "groundless smears and slanders."
